ui.chat.action.stopped.role: status word after a turn was stopped
ui.chat.action.stopped.tone: past participle, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.action.stopped.note: Follows the turn's own stop control, so it names what the reader did rather than a failure.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_collapse.role: accessible name of the session goal while its disclosure is open; the press closes it
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_collapse.tone: imperative verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_collapse.note: The goal's own text follows after an em dash, so this string carries no final punctuation. 'Session goal' is the region's name, kept identical to the expand arm's.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss.role: visible word on the control that puts a finished goal's chip away
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss.tone: one verb, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss.note: Not a deletion: the finished goal stays in the goal history, which the longer name states. This word sits on a 24px row and is dropped below the narrow column floor, where the control keeps its icon and accessible name.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss_kee.role: middle clause of the finished goal's dismiss accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss_kee.tone: declarative clause, lower-case start, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss_kee.note: Relays that the dismissal hides the row and keeps the record. It is joined between em dashes, so it stays lower case and takes no full stop.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss_nam.role: head of the finished goal's dismiss tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss_nam.tone: imperative verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss_nam.note: Followed by the keep clause and the goal itself, both after em dashes. It names dismissing the chip, not deleting the record that the next clause says survives.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_done.role: visible word on the control that records the goal as done
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_done.note: It marks the goal finished and records the decision; it is not a dismissing 'Done' from a dialog. A separate longer key names the action for screen readers, because 'Done' alone would not say what is done.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_done_name.role: head of the goal's done control in its accessible name and tooltip
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_done_name.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_done_name.note: The goal text follows after a dash. Nothing is destroyed: the record stays in the goal history.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_expand.role: accessible name of the session goal while its disclosure is closed; the press opens it
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_expand.tone: imperative verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_expand.note: The goal's own text follows after an em dash. 'Session goal' is the region's name, identical in both arms so the name does not change identity when it opens.

ui.chat.composer.status.goal_label.role: visible label at the head of the session goal chip
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_label.tone: noun with a colon, sentence case
ui.chat.composer.status.goal_label.note: The row's chips lead with the fact's name and a colon; the disambiguating words live in the accessible names.

ui.chat.composer.status.jobs_action.role: head of the jobs chip's tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.jobs_action.tone: imperative verb phrase plus the destination section, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.jobs_action.note: The count and state clauses follow after an em dash. 'Open' moves the reader to the run pane's Jobs section instead of disclosing something in place.

ui.chat.composer.status.loop_clear.role: action label on the loop chip's dismiss control once the loop has settled
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_clear.tone: verb plus object, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_clear.note: The settled state is cleared, never stopped - 'Stop' belongs to the running state only. This press sends no command: it clears the row's own acknowledgement of a settled loop.

ui.chat.composer.status.loop_label.role: visible label at the head of the loop chip
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_label.tone: noun with a colon, sentence case
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_label.note: The wire's own status word follows, untranslated, so the chip and the loop picker spell one state the same way.

ui.chat.composer.status.loop_progress_of.role: turn progress clause inside the loop chip and its accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_progress_of.tone: two counts with a trailing noun
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_progress_of.note: Rendered after a comma that follows the wire's status word. Keep both numbers and the noun; the wording is a fact about turns completed out of the loop's allowance.

placeholders.completed: number of turns the loop has completed
placeholders.total: number of turns the loop was allowed

ui.chat.composer.status.loop_progress_tu.role: turn count clause inside the loop chip when the loop carries no allowance
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_progress_tu.tone: a counted noun, pluralized by the locale's own rules
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_progress_tu.note: Rendered after a comma that follows the wire's status word. Plural categories are the locale's own; do not copy English's two-arm shape.

placeholders.count: number of turns completed so far

ui.chat.composer.status.loop_stop.role: action label on the loop chip's dismiss control while the loop is running
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_stop.tone: verb plus object, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.loop_stop.note: The running state is stopped; a settled loop is cleared instead, which is a separate key. The loop picker's own primary button says 'Cancel loop' - that dialog is a different control and does not share this wording.

ui.chat.composer.status.monitors_action.role: head of the monitors chip's tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.monitors_action.tone: imperative verb phrase plus the destination section, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.monitors_action.note: The armed-monitor count clause follows after an em dash. 'Open' moves the reader to the run pane's Monitors section instead of disclosing something in place; the plural matches that section's own heading.

ui.chat.composer.status.plan_action.role: head of the plan chip's tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.plan_action.tone: imperative verb phrase plus the destination section, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.plan_action.note: The to-do count clause follows after an em dash. 'Open' moves the reader to the run pane's To-dos section instead of disclosing something in place.

ui.chat.composer.status.session_goal.role: accessible name of the region that holds the authored session goal
ui.chat.composer.status.session_goal.note: A group name, not a heading: the goal is one authored paragraph that a keyboard reader must be able to scroll.

ui.chat.composer.status.subagents_action.role: head of the subagents chip's tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.subagents_action.tone: imperative verb phrase plus the destination section, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.subagents_action.note: The count and state clauses follow after an em dash. 'Open' moves the reader to the run pane's Subagents section instead of disclosing something in place.

ui.chat.composer.status.wakes_action.role: head of the wakes chip's tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer.status.wakes_action.tone: imperative verb phrase plus the destination section, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer.status.wakes_action.note: The armed-schedule count clause follows after an em dash. 'Open' moves the reader to the run pane's Wakes section instead of disclosing something in place.

ui.chat.hub_update.check_now.role: tooltip and accessible name of the hub refresh control
ui.chat.hub_update.check_now.note: Re-reads the hub for newer agent, team and skill versions; it downloads nothing by itself.

ui.chat.hub_update.dismiss.role: visible caption of the control that dismisses the hub update summary
ui.chat.hub_update.dismiss.note: Removes the summary line from the sidebar; it does not cancel an update in flight.

ui.chat.hub_update.dismiss_summary.role: accessible name of the control that dismisses the hub update summary
ui.chat.hub_update.dismiss_summary.note: The visible control says Dismiss; this name says what is being dismissed.

ui.chat.hub_update.update_all.tone: verb phrase with a count, sentence case
ui.chat.hub_update.update_all.note: The count is how many updates the press would apply. Keep the parentheses.

placeholders.count: number of updates the press would apply.

ui.chat.hub_update.update_all_label.role: accessible name of the update-all control
ui.chat.hub_update.update_all_label.tone: verb phrase with a count and the item kind
ui.chat.hub_update.update_all_label.note: `kind` selects the noun (agents, teams, skills) so each language can inflect it; the count is how many updates would be applied. Everything in ONE message because the noun and the count agree with each other.

placeholders.count: number of updates the press would apply.

ui.chat.hub_update.updating.role: update-all control caption while the update runs
ui.chat.hub_update.updating.tone: present participle, sentence case, trailing ellipsis
ui.chat.hub_update.updating.note: Shown in place of the count while a hub update is in flight.

ui.chat.provider_error.action.open_provi.role: action on any other provider error
ui.chat.provider_error.action.open_provi.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.provider_error.action.open_provi.note: Opens the provider settings grid. The subject is a per-provider setting surface, not the reader's account.

ui.chat.provider_error.action.open_radie.role: action on a Radient billing error
ui.chat.provider_error.action.open_radie.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.provider_error.action.open_radie.note: Opens the account surface that shows the balance and the top-up entry. `Radient` is the product name and stays untranslated; `account` is the reader's own account.

ui.chat.provider_error.action.sign_in_ra.role: action on a provider error that is Radient's own sign-in failure
ui.chat.provider_error.action.sign_in_ra.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.provider_error.action.sign_in_ra.note: `Radient` is the product name and stays untranslated; `Sign in` is the action. Only shown when the failing provider is Radient itself.

ui.chat.provider_error.headline.out_of_c.role: headline on an out-of-credits provider error
ui.chat.provider_error.headline.out_of_c.tone: statement with the vendor's own body
ui.chat.provider_error.headline.out_of_c.note: `{status}` already carries its leading space and parentheses (` (HTTP 402)`), so do not add punctuation around it. `{body}` is the provider's own sentence, shown verbatim and never translated. `Out of credits` is the app's own diagnosis.

placeholders.status: the HTTP status with its own parentheses and a leading space, or an empty string.
placeholders.body: the provider's own sentence, taken from the wire. Never translate or paraphrase it.

ui.chat.provider_error.headline.out_of_c.role: headline on an out-of-credits error with no body
ui.chat.provider_error.headline.out_of_c.note: Used when the relay gave a status but no body. `Radient` is the product name and stays untranslated. `{status}` carries its own leading space and parentheses.

placeholders.status: the HTTP status with its own parentheses and a leading space, or an empty string.

ui.chat.question_dock.asking.tone: short status sentence, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.question_dock.asking.note: Says the agent is waiting on an answer. The pill also carries `Show` beside it.

ui.chat.question_dock.from_agent_label.role: accessible name of the expanded question card
ui.chat.question_dock.from_agent_label.note: Landmark name for the card holding the agent's question and its options.

ui.chat.question_dock.secret_answer_labe.role: accessible name of the secret-answer form
ui.chat.question_dock.secret_answer_labe.note: This form appears only when the agent has asked for a secret; the value is masked and never written to the transcript.

ui.chat.question_dock.secret_note.role: reassurance line above the secret field
ui.chat.question_dock.secret_note.tone: one sentence, sentence case, trailing period
ui.chat.question_dock.secret_note.note: Claims three checkable things: the field masks the value, the value goes only to the asking agent, and the app keeps no record of it in the transcript. The em dash separates the masking claim from where the value goes.

ui.chat.question_dock.secret_placeholder.role: placeholder inside the masked secret field
ui.chat.question_dock.secret_placeholder.note: The value is pasted rather than typed on purpose: the clipboard path is the one the dock is designed around.

ui.chat.question_dock.secret_value_label.role: accessible name of the masked secret field
ui.chat.question_dock.secret_value_label.note: The field is a password input; its content is masked as typed.

ui.chat.question_dock.send.role: submit control under the secret field
ui.chat.question_dock.send.note: Sends the secret answer to the asking agent.

ui.chat.question_dock.show.note: Second half of the pill: what pressing it does.

ui.chat.question_dock.show_question_labe.role: accessible name of the collapsed question pill
ui.chat.question_dock.show_question_labe.note: Expands the agent's question back into the dock; it does not answer it.

ui.chat.quota_notice.dismiss.role: control that dismisses the quota notice
ui.chat.quota_notice.dismiss.note: Dismisses the notice for this conversation; it does not change the quota.

ui.chat.reply.remove.role: accessible name of the control that removes a staged reply
ui.chat.reply.remove.note: The control is an X icon; it removes this quoted reply from the draft, not from the transcript.

ui.chat.reply.replying_to.role: label on a quoted reply staged above the composer
ui.chat.reply.replying_to.tone: gerund phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.reply.replying_to.note: Announces that the message being sent quotes another message.

ui.chat.session_status.choose_model.role: model chip caption when no model is resolved
ui.chat.session_status.choose_model.note: Invites the reader to pick the model this conversation will run on; the chip opens the model picker. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.session_status.choose_model_tool.role: tooltip on the model chip when no model is resolved
ui.chat.session_status.choose_model_tool.note: Explains what the chip's press does: opens the picker for this conversation's model.

ui.chat.session_status.estimate.note: Marks a number the app estimated rather than read from the provider. Lowercase on purpose: it sits inline after the figure.

ui.chat.session_status.last_reading.role: mark beside a reading taken before a reconnect
ui.chat.session_status.last_reading.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.session_status.last_reading.note: Qualifies the numbers beside it: they were measured before the connection dropped and are not live. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.session_status.no_model_resolved.role: tooltip when a conversation has no model yet
ui.chat.session_status.no_model_resolved.note: Shown on the model chip in a new conversation before the backend has resolved a model.

ui.chat.skill_invocation.instructions_la.role: label above the skill instructions a `$name` invocation sent
ui.chat.skill_invocation.instructions_la.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.skill_invocation.instructions_la.note: Sits at the top of the recessed block a reader gets by expanding a `$skill` row's header. It names what the block is - the skill's own instructions, which the app sent on the reader's behalf - so keep it a description of the content and not an action. Space is a full-width prose column, so it may run to a line.

ui.chat.skill_invocation.trigger_label.role: accessible name of the control that expands a `$name` invocation's header (a button whose visible summary is the token, a separator and the skill's one-line purpose)
ui.chat.skill_invocation.trigger_label.tone: noun phrase naming the control's content, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.skill_invocation.trigger_label.note: Read by a screen reader INSTEAD of the visible summary, which is a token plus a purpose sentence that can run to 150 characters - the name says what the press opens. `{token}` is the invocation's resolved skill token including its leading `$` (for example `$seal-demo`), so the translation keeps the placeholder and does not add or drop the sign. The purpose sentence stays visible on the row and in its `title`.

ui.chat.status_strip.dismiss.role: accessible name of the control that dismisses a status strip notice
ui.chat.status_strip.dismiss.note: The control is an X icon; it hides this notice and does not fix what it reports.

ui.chat.tabs.chat.note: Switches the conversation pane to the rendered conversation.

ui.chat.tabs.raw.note: Switches the conversation pane to the raw message payload; `Raw` is the app's established word for machine JSON.

ui.chat.session_status.nothing_measured_.role: the sentence under the Context heading in the draft context tooltip

ui.chat.session_status.temporarily_unava.role: title of the model-access band when the provider is temporarily refusing access

ui.chat.session_status.temporarily_unava.note: Says the credential is still saved, which is the fact that makes retrying reasonable. Never imply the sign-in was lost or expired.
